Questions

Common questions.

Can one system run several campuses?

Yes. Each campus runs its own classes and fees, and owners see one combined view.

Do you support CBC?

Yes. Competency-based assessment and report cards are built in, alongside exam grading where still needed.

Can you build a learning platform, not only school admin?

Yes. Ongoza Cyber Hub is a learning and talent platform we built for 10,000+ students.
